name: Viewport accessibility lenses simulate colorblindness and preview 3x3 repeating tiles
description: Verify drawing a solid colored ball and patterns, cycling through CVD colorblindness simulation lenses (Protanopia, Deuteranopia, Tritanopia, Monochromacy), toggling squint contrast mode, and enabling 3x3 seamless tile matrix previews.

planSteps.description: Select the Ellipse tool (press O), ensure shape mode in context bar is 'Shape: Filled Solid', press down on canvas, drag diagonally for at least 150 pixels, and release to draw a prominent circle
Select the Flood Fill tool (press G), select a bright red color, and click inside the circle to solidly fill it
Select the Pen tool (press B), choose green, and draw green foliage accents around the red ball
Click the CVD Lens button in the top context options bar (or press P on keyboard)
Verify the viewport applies SVG color matrix filtering to simulate Protanopia
Click the CVD Lens button again to cycle to Deuteranopia
Click the CVD Lens button until it cycles back to OFF
Click the Squint Mode button in the top context options bar (labeled 'SIL')
Verify the canvas stage applies optical blur filtering for value and silhouette contrast auditing
Toggle Squint Mode off, then click the 3x3 button for Seamless Tile Preview
Verify 8 repeating border tiles surround the center canvas for real-time seamless tiling inspection
